# Identity and environment names

<!-- Generated by tools/identity/write-doc.mjs from tools/identity.json and tools/env-register.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every name that a build or an installation of impluvium shows to the outside comes from one table, `tools/identity.json`.
Every environment variable the project reads or declares is listed in the register, `tools/env-register.json`.
CI checks that both agree with the code and that this page is up to date.

## Change rule

Values in the identity table change only with the approval of the maintainer, together with a note on existing installations.
From the first public release candidate on, every change of a value is a breaking change.
Bindings that tie a value to the place in the code that uses it follow the code freely.

## Environment register

Names owned by the project start with `IMPLUVIUM_`; names owned by a tool or a framework keep their standard form.
Status is `active` (in use), `planned` (target name), `reserved` or `retired`. Evidence says whether project code reads the name or a tool or image does.
Names ending in `*` stand for a family of names. Shell scripts are not scanned; the only product script reads no project variable.

| Name | Kind | Component | Status | Evidence | Standard | Secret | Fate | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | runtime | server | active | read | yes | yes | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | PostgreSQL connection string, including the password. |
| `NODE_ENV` | runtime | server | active | read | yes | no | remove: When the inherited Node server is replaced. | Node environment switch (production or development). |
| `EXTERNAL_URL` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_EXTERNAL_URL`: With the Rust server configuration. | Public base URL of the server. |
| `DATA` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_DATA_DIR`: With the Rust server configuration. | Directory for server data. |
| `LIBRARY` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_LIBRARY_DIR`: With the Rust server configuration. | Directory that holds the game library. |
| `WEBAUTHN_DOMAIN` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_WEBAUTHN_RP_ID`: With the Rust server configuration. | Relying-party domain for passkey sign-in; defaults to the host of the external URL. |
| `DISABLE_SIMPLE_AUTH` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_DISABLE_PASSWORD_LOGIN`: With the Rust server configuration. | Turns off username and password sign-in. |
| `METADATA_TIMEOUT` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_METADATA_TIMEOUT`: With the Rust server configuration. | Timeout in milliseconds for metadata requests. |
| `CHECK_FOR_UPDATES` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | remove: With the removal of the update check against the upstream project. | Turns the check for new upstream releases on or off. |
| `OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Display name of the sign-in provider. |
| `OIDC_USER_GROUP` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_USER_GROUP`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Group whose members may sign in. |
| `OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Group whose members become administrators. |
| `OIDC_USERNAME_CLAIM` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_USERNAME_CLAIM`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Claim that supplies the user name. |
| `OIDC_WELLKNOWN` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_WELLKNOWN`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Discovery document URL of the provider. |
| `OIDC_SCOPES` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_SCOPES`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Requested scopes. |
| `OIDC_AUTHORIZATION` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_AUTHORIZATION`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Authorization endpoint when no discovery document is used. |
| `OIDC_TOKEN` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_TOKEN`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Token endpoint when no discovery document is used. |
| `OIDC_USERINFO` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_USERINFO`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. User info endpoint when no discovery document is used. |
| `OIDC_ISSUER` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_ISSUER`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Issuer when no discovery document is used. |
| `OIDC_JWKS` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_JWKS`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Key set endpoint when no discovery document is used. |
| `OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_CLIENT_ID`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Client identifier registered with the provider. |
| `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | runtime | server | active | read | no | yes | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Client secret registered with the provider. |
| `OIDC_REQUIRE_HTTPS` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_REQUIRE_HTTPS`: With the Rust server configuration. | OpenID Connect setting. Requires HTTPS for provider endpoints. |
| `IGDB_CLIENT_ID` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_IGDB_CLIENT_ID`: With the Rust metadata providers. | Client identifier for the IGDB metadata provider. |
| `IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET` | runtime | server | active | read | no | yes | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET`: With the Rust metadata providers. | Client secret for the IGDB metadata provider. |
| `PCGAMINGWIKI_BOT_USERNAME` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_PCGAMINGWIKI_BOT_USERNAME`: With the Rust metadata providers. | Bot account name for the PCGamingWiki metadata provider. |
| `PCGAMINGWIKI_BOT_PASSWORD` | runtime | server | active | read | no | yes | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_PCGAMINGWIKI_BOT_PASSWORD`: With the Rust metadata providers. | Bot password for the PCGamingWiki metadata provider. |
| `GIANT_BOMB_API_KEY` | runtime | server | active | read | no | yes | remove: When the metadata sources are reduced to four. | API key for the Giant Bomb metadata provider. |
| `TORRENTIAL_PATH` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | remove: When the inherited download service and web proxy are replaced. | Path of the download service binary. |
| `INTERNAL_DEPOT_URL` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | remove: When the inherited download service and web proxy are replaced. | Address of the download service. |
| `NGINX_CONFIG` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | remove: When the inherited download service and web proxy are replaced. | Path of the web proxy configuration. |
| `EXTERNAL_SERVICE_*` | runtime | server | active | read | no | no | remove: When the inherited download service and web proxy are replaced. | Per-service switch EXTERNAL_SERVICE_<NAME>: when set, the server does not launch that service itself. The name is built at run time. |
| `RUST_LOG` | runtime | desktop | active | read | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Log level filter for the desktop client. |
| `NO_TRAY_ICON` | runtime | desktop | active | read | no | no | rename to `IMPLUVIUM_NO_TRAY`: With the rewrite of the desktop client. | Starts the desktop client without a tray icon when set to true. |
| `FORCE_ENABLE_DEPOTS` | runtime | desktop | active | read | no | no | remove: With the removal of the inherited depot download path. | Forces the depot download path on. |
| `READER_THREADS` | runtime | torrential | active | read | no | no | remove: When the inherited download service and web proxy are replaced. | Number of reader threads of the download service. |
| `WORKING_DIRECTORY` | runtime | torrential | active | read | no | no | remove: When the inherited download service and web proxy are replaced. | Working directory of the download service. |
| `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR` | test | build | active | read | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Set by Cargo; the Rust tests read it through env! to find their data. |
| `NODE_BASE_IMAGE` | build | build | active | consumer: container build (ARG in the Dockerfile) | no | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Build argument that selects the pinned Node base image. |
| `RUST_BUILD_IMAGE` | build | build | active | consumer: container build (ARG in the Dockerfile) | no | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Build argument that selects the pinned Rust build image. |
| `PNPM_HOME` | build | build | active | consumer: pnpm | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Install location of pnpm inside the build image. |
| `PATH` | build | build | active | consumer: the shell and the container runtime | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Executable search path, extended in the build image. |
| `COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT` | build | build | active | consumer: Corepack | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Silences the Corepack download prompt in the build image. |
| `COREPACK_ENABLE_NETWORK` | build | build | active | consumer: Corepack | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Forbids Corepack network access in the build image. |
| `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN` | build | build | active | consumer: rustup | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Pins the Rust toolchain in the build image. |
| `PORT` | runtime | server | active | consumer: the Node server (set in the Dockerfile) | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Port the server listens on. |
| `NUXT_PORT` | runtime | server | active | consumer: Nuxt (declared in the example environment file) | yes | no | remove: When the inherited Node server is replaced. | Port of the Nuxt development server. |
| `NUXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED` | build | server | active | consumer: Nuxt | yes | no | remove: When the inherited Node server is replaced. | Turns off Nuxt telemetry. |
| `NUXT_*` | runtime | server | active | consumer: Nuxt (runtime configuration overrides) | yes | no | remove: When the inherited Node server is replaced. | Nuxt maps NUXT_<KEY> variables onto its runtime configuration without any code reading them. |
| `POSTGRES_USER` | runtime | deploy | active | consumer: the PostgreSQL container image | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Database user of the example deployment. |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | runtime | deploy | active | consumer: the PostgreSQL container image | yes | yes | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that reads it. | Database password of the example deployment. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_EXTERNAL_URL` | runtime | server | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | Public base URL of the server. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_DATA_DIR` | runtime | server | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | Directory for server data; also used by the engine tests. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_LIBRARY_DIR` | runtime | server | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | Directory that holds the game library. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_WEBAUTHN_RP_ID` | runtime | server | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | Relying-party domain for passkey sign-in. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_DISABLE_PASSWORD_LOGIN` | runtime | server | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | Turns off username and password sign-in. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_METADATA_TIMEOUT` | runtime | server | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | Timeout in milliseconds for metadata requests. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_OIDC_*` | runtime | server | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | OpenID Connect settings; one variable per former OIDC_ name. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_IGDB_*` | runtime | server | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | IGDB provider settings; one variable per former IGDB_ name. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_PCGAMINGWIKI_*` | runtime | server | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | PCGamingWiki provider settings; one variable per former PCGAMINGWIKI_ name. |
| `IMPLUVIUM_NO_TRAY` | runtime | desktop | planned | read | no | no | keep: Not planned; this is the target name. | Starts the desktop client without a tray icon. |
| `CARGO_PKG_VERSION` | build | desktop | active | read | yes | no | keep: Not planned; the name belongs to the tool that sets it. | Set by Cargo; the desktop user-agent helper reads it through env! to report the crate version. |
